build_EfficientGraphAttentionBlock: build a graph attention block with normalization, stochastic depth, and feed-forward networks for molecular graphs
build_EfficientGraphAttention: build an efficient graph attention module with multi-head self-attention and frequency embeddings for molecular graphs
run_EfficientGraphAttentionBlock_forward: run the graph attention block forward pass with node and edge features using residual connections
run_EfficientGraphAttention_multi_head_s: run multi-head self-attention with optional frequency vector expansion and scaled dot-product attention
run_EfficientGraphAttention_graph_attent: run graph attention aggregation to compute attention-weighted node outputs from edge outputs and neighbor masks
